label: run134 storageas cc steam
definition: run132 keeper recipe (storage-AS reserve credit, 2025-scoped) re-solved on the new combined-cycle steam-turbine outage coupling — i.e. run132's config paired with run133's regenerated campd-unit-outages.csv (a downed CC combustion turbine now derates its allocated HRSG-steam share, deepening CC derates, e.g. Wolf Hollow II 29%->50%). This is the run133 probe done right: run133 paired the new outage data with run131's recipe (it dropped the storage-AS credit); run134 keeps run132's full config. Config is byte-identical to run132 (same flags, offer curves, gas prices); only the outage data differs. Result (run132 keeper -> run134, act in parens): 2025 MAE 2.7->6.5, avg 33.9->37.9 (act 32.5), tail >200/>500 8/6->18/9 (act 31/3); 2024 MAE 10.5->13.2, avg 29.0->33.7 (act 26.7), tail 49/28->69/43 (act 53/16); 2023 MAE 10.5->11.9, avg 46.7->49.8 (act 48.1), tail 151/88->171/94 (act 181/104). The deeper CC derates tighten supply and re-inflate 2024/2025 LMP — undoing the 2025 overshoot run132 closed — while only nudging the 2023 tail toward actual. Volumes hold (gas/coal split Delta within +/-1.5pp every year; a pure price-side effect). Net regression vs run132, so the CC steam-turbine outage coupling is NOT adopted into the ERCOT keeper. (PROBE)
